description: A Southern California Republican Member of the House has an immediate need to hire a full-time Field Representative. The Field Representative serves an important role in the Member's Congressional District, acting as a liaison with federal, district, and local agencies for the Member and constituents. They are responsible for strengthening community relations and assessing casework for problems requiring legislative action and/or Congressional oversight. Under the supervision of the Chief of Staff and the District Director, the Field Representative briefs the Member in preparation for district meetings with constituents and acts as the representative for the Member by attending events and meetings, including public speaking and certificate presentations.
